name: macp_decision_evaluation
description: Evaluation: records an analysis of a proposal. It is advisory; a BLOCK recommendation does not trigger veto logic (RFC-MACP-0007 Section 4). Sent as message_type Evaluation in mode macp.mode.decision.v1.

recommendation.description: The evaluator's recommendation. Values are case-sensitive. REVIEW means analyzed without a definitive stance.

confidence.description: The evaluator's confidence in its recommendation.
